message:
The other evening, we had a surprise blackout, and at first, I admit I felt a little lost. But then I remembered my trusty power bank and those cute little lanterns I had tucked away. I grabbed a couple of blankets, set up a cozy little spot in the living room, and turned it into an impromptu movie night with some downloaded shows. 

It was surprisingly fun to unplug and enjoy the glow of the lanterns while we munched on popcorn and shared stories. Sometimes, a little unexpected moment like this can turn into a lovely memory! 

What’s your favorite way to make the best of a blackout?
